{{Top|leg}}
The '''droid repulsor''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] utility item with technology similar to [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] in that it created an artificial gravity wake around the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], thereby randomizing the gravity surrounding its enemies and slowing their movement.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 1 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
